The reporter also uses phrases such as ‘defied the odds’ and ‘such achievements were once unimaginable’ to draw attention to how Noon has overcome significant adversity in her life. The article shows how Noon’s Indigenous background and cultural knowledge give her unique insights into the traditional study of astronomy.
